labels.text: Sign in to start chatting in Chrome.

S3.01.needs: an AGI account (email or outside provider login)
S3.01.note: The same sign-in also opens from Options > Account > Sign in and from the welcome page's Sign in button. The sign-in tab goes to /sign-in, which apps/web/next.config.ts redirects to /login.
steps: Open the AGI side panel in Chrome while signed out (click the AGI toolbar icon).
Read the notice in the composer area: "Sign in to start chatting in Chrome."
Click the "Sign in" button. A new tab opens on the AGI sign-in page.
Finish signing in in that tab, return to the side panel and click "Check sign-in".
Compare: the side panel should show you as signed in and the chat should be usable, as Expected says.
S3.01.where: Side panel > composer area shows "Sign in to start chatting in Chrome." > Sign in

S3.02.needs: a new email address or an outside account (Google)
S3.02.note: The extension has no sign-up screen of its own. It only hands off to the web sign-in page (/sign-in, redirected to /login in apps/web/next.config.ts), and apps/web/features/auth/authRoutes.ts defines /signup. The exact create-account wording is on the web page and was not confirmed in the code.
steps: Open the AGI side panel while signed out.
Click "Sign in" in the composer area.
In the new tab that opens, look for the option to create a new account (wording not verified in the extension code).
Create an account with email or a provider, then return to the side panel and click "Check sign-in".
Compare: the new account should reach a signed-in state in the side panel, as Expected says.
S3.02.where: Side panel > Sign in > create a new account on the AGI sign-in page that opens in a new tab

S3.19.needs: a Free account, with the Terms version changed on the server
S3.19.note: The extension has no Terms acceptance screen. apps/extension/src/features/cloud-bridge/freeTrialClient.ts only turns a TERMS_ACCEPTANCE_REQUIRED error into a block message to accept the updated Terms on agiworkforce.com. Acceptance is recorded on the web at apps/web/app/signup/complete/RecordTermsAcceptance.tsx. I searched apps/extension/src for terms, Terms of Service and terms_required and found no acceptance control.

S3.25.note: No memory setup step or memory-use choice was found in apps/extension/src. The closest screens are the side panel account menu > Memory (apps/extension/src/side_panel.ts, label "Memory", sheet intro "What AGI remembers about you in every app...") and Options > Account > Your account > Memory > Open, which opens the web memory settings. I searched apps/extension/src for memory, spMemory and remember strings.

S3.30.needs: AGI Desktop app open and showing a pairing code
S3.30.note: Options nav labels are Permissions, Shortcuts, Options, Account and Help. The pairing rows are built in apps/extension/src/features/options/desktop-pairing-rows.ts and placed in the Account section by apps/extension/src/features/options/destinations.ts. The side panel's Desktop connection menu label is not shown in the side panel UI found in code.
steps: Open the Options page: click "Open settings" on the welcome page, or open the AGI extension's Options from Chrome's extensions menu.
Click "Account" in the left navigation and scroll to "Desktop app".
Click "Pair with Desktop", type the code shown by AGI Desktop in the field (placeholder ABCD-EFGH), then click "Confirm Code".
Compare: the status should change from "Not paired" to paired, and the "Unpair" button should appear, as Expected says.
Click "Unpair", read the message "Unpair the desktop app? ...", then click "Unpair" again or "Keep paired" to check the way back out.
S3.30.where: Options > Account > Desktop app > Pair with Desktop

S3.32.note: No first-run notification primer was found. The toggle is on by default (apps/extension/src/features/options/notifications-row.ts reads agi_task_notifications with a default of true), so declining means switching it off on the Options page.
steps: Open the Options page: click "Open settings" on the welcome page, or open the AGI extension's Options from Chrome's extensions menu.
Click "Options" in the left navigation.
Find the "Task completion notifications" row and read its hint.
Switch the toggle off and back on. Compare: the status reads "Task completion notifications are off." or "...are on."
Compare the toggle with Expected: it is optional and can be changed later.

S3.35.needs: a fresh install or a profile whose tour is not finished
S3.35.note: The tour is mounted by apps/extension/src/features/side-panel/onboardingPrompt.ts above the composer (apps/extension/src/side_panel.ts). It finishes on the shortcuts step and does not itself start a chat. After install, the welcome page (apps/extension/src/features/onboarding/welcome-page.ts) opens first, with an "Open side panel" button.
steps: Install AGI, or use a profile where the side panel tour has not been finished, then open the AGI side panel.
Read the first tour step above the composer: "AGI reads a page only when you attach it or ask it to act there."
Click "Next" and read the shortcuts step.
Click "Let's go" to finish the tour.
Compare: the bar should go away and the composer should be ready for a first chat, as Expected says.
S3.35.where: Side panel, first open after install > "Getting started with AGI" bar above the composer > Next > Let's go
